[Intro]
[Ab5]

[Verse 1]
[Ab5]The days are getting short
again
Leaves fall from the trees
[Ab5]Nights are haunted by how
ling winds
Harbinger of the dreeze
[Db5]But sometimes there's no way
to know
[Ab5]
[Eb5]Until it's
[Db5]too late and
[Ab5]You wake up to an ear
ly snow

[Verse 2]
[Ab5]Eyes have become cold
again
A distant light from the trees
[Ab5]Waiting for winter to
begin
Before it's up to your
knees
[Db5]But sometimes there's no way
to know
[Ab5]
[Eb5]Until it's
[Db5]too late and
[Ab5]You wake up to an ear
ly snow

[Pre-Chorus]
[Db5]Brace yourself against
the cold
[Ab5]Wish you could have stayed
in bed
[Db5]Follow me for bread
and gold
[Eb5]An ancient nexus lies
ahead

[Solo]
[Ab5]

[Bridge]
[Ab]When the days become warm
again
Mountains covered with green
Flower's bloom as the clouds
roll by
Ain't a better sight
[Db]to be seen

[Intrelude]
[Ab5]
[Db]
[Ab5]
[Db]
[Ab5]
[Db]
[Ab5]
[Db]

[Outro 1]
[Ab5]Brace yourself against
[Db]the cold
[Ab5]There's a road we all must
[Gb]tend [Db/F]
[Ab5]Fallen leaves of red
[Db]and gold
[Ab5]An ancient nexus lies
[Db]ahead

[Outro 2]
[Ab5]
title: Early Snow
tuning: D# G# C# F# A# D#
